apiTokens.title: API tokens
apiTokens.intro: API tokens let you, your scripts, integrations and AI agents call the Twake Space API. A personal token acts as you; an organization token acts for the whole organization.

usage.title: Quick start
usage.step1: Create a token and copy it. It is shown only once.
usage.step2: Send it in the Authorization header of every request, as Bearer <token>.
usage.step3: Call the routes its permissions open. Requests and answers are JSON.
usage.agents: Building an AI agent? Each new token comes with a ready-to-paste brief: the base URL, the header and the routes it may call.
